boundary_conditions: A prescribed support-loss comparator does not identify a historical initiating cause or intentional act.
competing_models: Underdetermination from unavailable UAF executable inputs
contrast_definition: UAF-declared NIST-initiation condition versus UAF-declared prescribed broad-support-loss comparator.
falsification_conditions: A source-complete independent rerun produces global progression from the NIST initiation condition under UAF-declared assumptions, or does not reproduce the stated broad-support-loss dependence.
null_model: The UAF implementation does not reproduce its reported initiation result, or a source-complete model under the stated UAF assumptions propagates from the NIST initiation condition.
observable_prediction: An independently executed, source-pinned UAF baseline reproduces the report’s limited relative displacement under the NIST initiation condition and requires a separately prescribed broad-support-loss condition for its global-collapse comparator.
primary_estimand: Matched-run propagation classification under the UAF-declared initiation condition; no inference to historical cause.
scope: WTC 7 UAF-specific comparison models; only source-pinned UAF decks and declared assumptions.
statement: Under the UAF report’s declared connection geometry, restraint, and loading assumptions, the NIST Column 79 initiation mechanism does not propagate to the reported global-collapse sequence without broader prescribed support loss.
support_conditions: Exact UAF case-entry decks, solver version, and result extraction procedure are preserved.
